sources.title: GERNOT FISCHER-KONDRATOVITCH
sources.supports: born 1968 in Villach; Caracas 1989/90, Mozarteum graphic art 1990–95, Academy Vienna 1995–97 diploma; freelance since 1997; lives in Vienna and Carinthia; performance/music/video in the exhibition list
sources.note: The "Biografie" page of the site. The paintings on oriental carpets are not named on this page.

sources.original: artist sheet in the exhibition Trigeniale Brda 26 (bewegungINkultur)
sources.title: Artist sheet Margrit Pernull (Trigeniale Brda 26)
sources.supports: born 1958 in Gmünd, Hermagor since 1980, occupational therapist, Freie Akademie Klagenfurt from 2018, diploma 2023, painting group Milan Baltić since 2021, solo show Pressegger See 2022, group shows 2023–2024 (BV Galerie, Gewölbegalerie, Sodalitas Tainach)
sources.note: Printed sheet on the hall wall of Kmetija Moro, read from the owner's 360° photo 09 (worklog plans/2026-11-09__trigeniale-brda-26-kmetija-moro/worklog.md). No online copy found.

sources.title: Trigeniale Brda im Herbst
sources.supports: Pernull from Hermagor shows in Trigeniale Brda 26 at Kmetija Moro; member of the painting group Milan Baltić; works "Weißensee", "Landschaft Früchte und Blumen" (picture captions)
sources.note: The announcement of 18 Sep 2026 (https://www.meinbezirk.at/klagenfurt/c-regionauten-community/neue-dreilaenderausstellung-trigeniale-brda-26-in-gorika-brda_a8905011) adds the caption with her Nockberge landscapes.

sources.title: PEPO PICHLER BIOGRAPHY
sources.supports: born 1948 in Klagenfurt; Academy Vienna 1968–73 under Max Weiler; travels in South/Central America and Mexico; San Francisco from 1975; since 1992 half the year in San Francisco and St. Margarethen/Lavanttal; 2023 Grand Prix for "MIRROR MIRROR" (Kunst und Handwerk); Gut Schmelzhofen

sources.title: Katharina Acht
sources.supports: born 1982 in Gmunden, grew up in Ohlsdorf; graphic design HTL 2001; Kunstuniversität Linz, fine arts/experimental design 2006; led Die Kunstschaffenden 2015–2021; nextcomic festival since 2018; Roitham am Traunfall since 2023
sources.note: Member profile of Kunstverein postWERK (URL dated 2014, text updated since).

sources.title: . about
sources.supports: same biography plus CV: born 1982 in Gmunden, HTL graphic design 1996–2001, Kunstuniversität Linz diploma 2006, president of Die Kunstschaffenden 2015–2021, nextcomic since 2018, Roitham am Traunfall since 2023

sources.title: Laurids Ortner
sources.supports: architecture at TU Wien; 1967 co-founder of Haus-Rucker-Co in Vienna; professor in Linz 1976–87; professor at Kunstakademie Düsseldorf 1987–2011; 2020 Grand Austrian State Prize with Manfred Ortner
sources.note: Birth (Linz 1941), study years 1959–1965 and the 1987 founding of the Düsseldorf office are not on this page (the Haus-Rucker-Co page https://www.ortner-ortner.com/de/haus-rucker-co names 1987 own offices).

sources.title: Über Mich
sources.supports: psychology degree Klagenfurt 2006; Freie Akademie from 2007, teaches there; freelance since 2009; member of the Berufsvereinigung; comic "Die Dachziegl" in "Die Brücke" since October 2012; lives in Klagenfurt
sources.note: Birth year 1978 not found on this page.

sources.title: Curriculum Vitae
sources.supports: born 12 December 1961 in Vienna; physics University of Vienna 1982–84; Academy Vienna graphic art with Melcher, diploma 1986; works in public space incl. "Wasserringe" fountain for the kärnten.museum 2023

sources.title: Armin Guerino (Biografien Armin Guerino, Gabriele Ruff)
sources.supports: born 1961 in Vienna; physics 1982–84; graphic art with Maximilian Melcher, diploma 1986; temporary and permanent projects in public space; lives and works in Vienna and at Schloss Saager
sources.note: PDF of the Alpen-Adria-Galerie for "Durch die Zeit" (2026).

sources.title: WAGNER RELOADED – Künstlerbiografien
sources.supports: whole biography: born in Vienna; HTBLVA Spengergasse textile design 1999; costume painter training ART for ART; 2003–2011 freelance (Josefstadt, Burgtheater, Volksoper, Bielefeld, Bregenz Festival); Fame (Oper Graz 2012), Der Mann von La Mancha (Gärtnerplatztheater); head of design costume/make-up since 2011/12, head of costume dept. since 2022/23; Tristan und Isolde

sources.title: Esther Stocker
sources.supports: born 1974 in Schlanders, Italy; Academy Vienna 1994 (Eva Schlegel); Brera Milan 1996; Art Center College of Design Pasadena 1999; lives and works in Vienna (section "Biografie")

sources.title: Daniel Hosenberg | visual artist
sources.supports: born 1985 in Carinthia; HfbK Hamburg 2007–2010; works from photographs, notes and memories gathered on walks through the city; 2023 Förderpreis für bildende Kunst, Land Kärnten; based in Vienna

sources.title: Über uns
sources.supports: president Peter Türk, vice-president Margaretha Maria Bauer; branch founded November 1949; own gallery; address Feldkirchnerstraße 31, Klagenfurt
sources.note: The site answers only over http (https fails, checked 2026-11-09). The page has no <title>; heading taken from the menu item "Über uns".

sources.title: Künstler T26-1+2 (artist sheets of Trigeniale 26, German)
sources.supports: lives and works in Monfalcone; charcoal and mixed media; guitar, choral and lyrical singing; exhibiting since 2015 (ENDAS, Cividale); Dreams & Vision Venice, MIITTAC Turin, ARS IN TEMPORE Treviso, 100 Jahre Isonzo-Front Kanal; Rome, Croatia, Hungary
sources.note: Organiser's PDF, local copy: _360_GALLERIES_AND_TOURS/collection/_galleries/studiogalerie_klagenfurt/2026-10-15-studiogalerie-klagenfurt-trigeniale-26/_Material/Künstler T26-1+2 - deutsch.pdf. No online copy found; the meinbezirk report on Trigeniale 26 (a8961771) mentions her but holds no biography.

sources.title: About me
sources.supports: born 1981 in Klagenfurt; history and cultural studies Graz and Vienna, Bologna 2004–05; Graphische 2006–2008; Friedl Kubelka school; freelance photographer in Klagenfurt and Vienna since 2009; lecturer in photography and photo theory at the University of Klagenfurt

sources.title: Originelle, witzige und hintergründige Kunstwerke
sources.supports: born in Klagenfurt; heads, figures and objects mainly from used textiles and carpets; Greek mythology and family history; recycling, throwaway society, role of women in sewing and mending; exhibition "Zwischen Affen und Göttern" at the Stadtgalerie im Amthof, Feldkirchen (2023)
sources.note: The 2026 Porcia exhibition "Aus der Asche empor" is not in this article.

sources.title: BIODIVERSITÄT ENTDECKEN – Kleine Künstler*innen für eine große Vielfalt
sources.supports: school classes from all over Carinthia, kidsmobil workshop of the wissens.wert.welt (kärnten.museum), animal rescue islands from natural materials near their schools; Living Studio, 30 May – 6 September 2026
sources.note: Section on the Living Studio archive page 2026. The list of the 17 schools is the linked PDF https://www.stadtgalerie.net/fileadmin/user_upload/Stadtgalerie_Klagenfurt/Living_Studio/Ausstellungsarchiv/2026/Biodiversitaet/Liste_teilnehmende_Schulen.pdf

sources.title: About
sources.supports: born 1983 in Klagenfurt; Kunstuniversität Linz, experimental audiovisual arts and cultural studies; UCSB and Berlin University of the Arts; photography, video, film, sound, installation; "Bodies of Work"; "Mir Metro" (Hatje Cantz, 2021); lives in Vienna and Linz

sources.title: Peter Kohlweiß – Gehen & Sehen (exhibition flyer)
sources.supports: painting since 1982, first experience with Prof. Hans Piccottini at HTL Villach; courses and seminars; watercolours and drawings of nature and architecture; a hobby; Café s'Kunstwerk Döbriach 2024 and 2025; Parkschlössl 25 Aug – 4 Sep 2026
sources.note: Flyer of the Kulturamt, local copy: _360_GALLERIES_AND_TOURS/collection/_galleries/parkschloessl_spittal/2026-08-24-parkschloessl-spittal-peter-kohlweiss/poster.pdf. No online copy found (spittal-drau.at gallery pages, press releases and event PDFs checked).

sources.supports: the Kulturamt presented the exhibition at the Parkschlössl in 2026
sources.note: No page of the Kulturamt on spittal-drau.at names Kohlweiß or the exhibition (site search, /kultur/galerie, press releases pages 1–8 checked). The Kulturamt is named as publisher on the flyer above; probably the same source.

sources.title: Biography
sources.supports: born in Villach; 1984 degree in mathematics and physics, University of Graz; since 1991 interdisciplinary art/science/technology projects; computer graphics, media installation, metal sculpture, conceptual art; art in architecture and public space; lives in Klagenfurt, Graz and Vienna
sources.note: Birth year 1960 not on this page. Page language is marked en, the text is German.
